description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableJsonField' implementing the 'JsonField' interface, representing a JSON field with key, value, and optional definition. It includes methods for creation, accessors, equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonField
classes.description: An immutable implementation of a JSON field with key, value, and optional definition, providing methods for creation, comparison, and serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonField with specified key and value, optionally with a definition.

methods.name: getKeyName
methods.description: Returns the key name as a string.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JsonFieldDefinition if present.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if the field is marked with specified markers.

methods.name: writeKeyAndValue
methods.description: Serializes the key and value using the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on key and value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash based on key and value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation, caching the result.

methods.name: getEscapedKeyName
methods.description: Returns the escaped key name for JSON serialization.
